passages.text: From the senses comes sensual pleasure. Beyond sensual pleasure is the pleasure that surmounts the sensual, which is said to be the best of these.
passages.note: Seeking deeper happiness beyond sensory pleasures

passages.text: Suppose there was a little baby bound with swaddling up to the neck. As they grow up and their senses mature, they’re accordingly released from those bonds. They’d know ‘I’m released,’ and there would be no more bonds.
passages.note: Growing up and outgrowing what once bound you
